title: ChatGPT Needed Just 2 Months For Mass Adoption
hook: ChatGPT reached mass adoption in only 2 months.
closing: That speed let one service shape global AI habits before rivals caught up.
question: Was that adoption too fast?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users. The early rush became a lasting global habit.
ChatGPT needed 2 months to hit its milestone. The old app-adoption timeline collapsed.
ChatGPT serves 850 million free users. Mass adoption creates a huge cost before most people ever pay.
